hero.title: Run your tournament. Not your spreadsheets.
hero.description: Manage tournaments, teams, matches, map vetoes and statistics in one system.

problem.title: Running a tournament shouldn't feel like a second job.
problem.description: Organizers spend too much time managing the work around the tournament instead of the tournament itself.

tools.title: Scattered information
tools.description: Tournament data lives across spreadsheets, bracket tools, documents, and other disconnected places.

manual.title: Too much manual work
manual.description: Teams, matches, results, and statistics often have to be managed manually.

visibility.title: No single source of truth
visibility.description: It's difficult to manage and track the tournament, matches, teams, and results from one place.

lifecycle.title: From setup to final result.
lifecycle.description: Manage every stage of your tournament in one system.

create.title: Create the tournament
create.description: Set the format, rules, teams, and tournament settings in one place.

teams.title: Manage teams
teams.description: Add teams and players and manage their participation throughout the tournament.

bracket.title: Build the tournament
bracket.description: Set up and manage your tournament structure with Bracket or Swiss format.

matches.title: Run the matches
matches.description: Schedule matches, record results, and keep track of the tournament in real time.

veto.title: Run the map veto
veto.description: Let teams complete the map veto and record the final maps and sides.

results.title: Finalize the results
results.description: Record results and statistics, then publish the tournament in its final state.

tournamentManagement.title: Everything your tournament needs. In one place.
tournamentManagement.description: Manage brackets, Swiss, teams, matches, announcements, scheduling, and results from one system.
tournamentManagement.imageAlt: Zonter tournament management dashboard showing tournament structure, teams, matches, and results
tournamentManagement.caption: Everything your tournament needs in one workspace

teamsPlayers.title: Manage teams and players beyond a single tournament.
teamsPlayers.description: Keep teams and players organized at the organization level. Reuse teams across tournaments, manage rosters, and track participation history in one place.

matchCenter.title: Every match. Everything that matters.
matchCenter.description: Manage the complete match from format and maps to the final result and player performance, all in one place.

mapVeto.title: Run every veto with a clear, structured flow.
mapVeto.description: Let teams complete the map veto in real time. Support BO1, BO3, and BO5 with bans, picks, decider maps, and CT/T side selection.
mapVeto.imageAlt: ZMap map veto interface showing the map selection process
mapVeto.caption: Powered by ZMap · Built for competitive CS2 matches

statistics.title: Every result. Every number.
statistics.description: Track player and team performance across matches and tournaments. Keep K/D/A, damage, ADR, KD, HS%, KAST, and MVP records in one system.

organization.title: One organization. Everything connected.
organization.description: Manage your teams, tournaments, players, and matches from one organization-level workspace.
organization.imageAlt: Zonter organization dashboard showing teams, tournaments, players, and matches
organization.caption: Organization-level tournament management

publicPages.title: Give every tournament a public home.
publicPages.description: Publish organization and tournament pages where anyone can explore teams, brackets, matches, results, announcements, and statistics.
publicPages.imageAlt: Zonter public organization and tournament pages showing teams, matches, brackets, results, and statistics
publicPages.caption: Public pages for organizations and tournaments

audience.title: Built for tournaments that need structure.
audience.description: Zonter is designed for organizers running competitive CS2 tournaments at the community, university, and amateur level.

community.title: Community tournaments
community.description: Run local and online community tournaments with a structured workflow for teams, matches, results, and public pages.

university.title: University esports
university.description: Organize campus leagues and university competitions while keeping teams, players, matches, and tournament history connected.

amateur.title: Amateur competitions
amateur.description: Manage smaller competitive events without relying on scattered spreadsheets, manual updates, and disconnected tools.

finalCta.title: Ready to run your next tournament?
finalCta.description: Bring your tournament workflow into one system and start managing it with Zonter.

footer.description: A tournament operating system built for CS2 organizers.

0.head: This is not a tournament tool. It is a tournament operating system.
0.sub: Build, manage, and control CS2 competitions like infrastructure — not spreadsheets.

1.head: You don't join tournaments. You control them.
1.sub: Design brackets, define rules, and run competitive systems with precision.

2.head: Built for organizers, not spectators.
2.sub: Every feature is designed for people who create structure, not consume it.

3.head: Competition needs structure. Zonter is that structure.
3.sub: From small community cups to university leagues — everything stays organized.

4.head: A new layer for competitive CS2 infrastructure.
4.sub: Not a platform. Not a dashboard. A control layer for esports operations.
